false_assurance_claims: Calls the createTransport-throws path 'fine' without evidence about the external factory, which is out of scope.
additional_supported_gaps: DELETE /mcp does not remove the session entry or close the transport, and there is no session cap or TTL.
The bearer comparison at line 7 is not constant-time and has no throttling.
There is no POST /mcp route, so clients may not be able to send messages.
notes: The report found the core issue with file and line evidence and respected the gateway and runtime scope. Its weaknesses are authority and coverage. It says it did not open research/, so its Express 4 and Node 20 claims and its Streamable HTTP claim have no dated primary references, even though they were available. It also has no coverage ledger and does not resolve launch.json. It gives no deployment verdict.
